metrics.name: prop_chose_higher_ev
metrics.description: On trials where one option has a clearly higher expected value, proportion of trials where the agent picked the higher-EV option. Random ~0.50; humans typically 0.70-0.80. (The previous prop_chose_risky metric, with baseline 0.45, was dropped in the v1.1 audit because random play (~0.50) was within one SD of its baseline and the metric could not discriminate random from risk-averse human play.)
